newsitems.title: Thank you for 10,000 wishlists!
newsitems.author: puckredflix
newsitems.contents: Dice Hoarder reached 10,000 wishlists in its first 24 hours and we are incredibly grateful for all your support and excitement for the game! It means the world to us seeing so many dice lovers eager to play. We can't wait for all of you dice hoarders to make your way into our little dice shop!Just please make sure to stay out of the basement... and stay focused on the job! We are now growing our team to make sure we can give dice collectors a game they will truly love. We hope to announce a release date and share much more about Dice Hoarder very soon! Have a dice day! DieCorp Games
